profile_md: Aston provision found is distributed and mostly Business School based. The Aston Business Clinic puts student teams (ABC Originals, 8 weeks, Masters; ABC for Placement, 20-30 weeks, undergraduates) in front of external businesses and charities with a coach, and meets all three criteria on page text, but it is optional, credit is unstated and the page is undated, so current delivery is unconfirmed. The Aston London Interdisciplinary Collaborative Project ends in two assessed business challenges set by external organisations with multi-disciplinary teams, but level, credit, output and partners are unstated. BSc Business Enterprise and Innovation has core 30-credit consultancy projects whose client is 'live or simulated'. The legacy Aston Global Advantage row was reassessed: it is a strand of postgraduate taught programmes (not MBA or MRes) listing team challenges and live briefs as possible activities, so it is an umbrella lead and not verified as a qualifying route, and is not university-wide. Industry Clubs, MBA consultancy, Design Factory and postgraduate Business Projects are leads without module-level evidence. No dated 2025/26 or 2026/27 evidence was found for any route. No qualifying scheme verified with current delivery through the documented search.
gaps: Reduced-depth review (about 8 searches plus 9 fetches). No dated current-year evidence; credit and eligibility of Aston Business Clinic unclear; Aston London module detail; Industry Club module links and the CEPS student-led enterprise not identified; AGA stream-two page requires login (not retrievable); no law, health or science team-client modules found; further departmental instances likely. Retrieval was WebFetch (fetch-tool summaries, not verbatim page text) and WebSearch extracts.
